title: Methods of generating human pluripotent stem cell-derived alveolar stem cells and their expansion
protocol: Prepare feeder medium consisting of DMEM 500 ml, FBS 38.2 ml (7 %), L-glutamine 5.5 ml (2 mM) and penicillin and streptomycin 2.7 ml.
Store the prepared feeder medium at 4 °C.
Add bFGF to primate ES cell medium (ReproCELL) at a concentration of 4 ng/ml to prepare ES medium.
Store the prepared ES medium at 4 °C and use within two weeks after preparation.
Prepare CTK solution consisting of 2.5% Trypsin 5 ml, collagenase IV stock solution (1 mg/ml) 5 ml, 0.1 M CaCl2 stock solution 0.5 ml, KSR 10 ml, and sterilized water 30 ml.
Store the CTK solution at -20 °C.
Warm the feeder medium at 37°C on day -2 or -1 before use.
Coat dishes with a 0.1% gelatin solution for 30 minutes at 37 °C in a CO2 incubator before seeding feeder cells.
Prepare a 10-cm dish coated with 5 ml of 0.1% gelatin at least 30 minutes before step 2.
Warm ES medium at 37°C on day 0 before seeding human pluripotent stem cells (PSCs).
Warm CTK solution at 37°C before passaging the cells.
Thaw a stock vial of STO feeder cells with prewarmed feeder medium (day -2 or -1).
Seed mitomycin-treated STO feeder cells on the gelatin-coated tissue-culture dishes (1.5 x 10^6 cells per 10-cm dish).
Thaw a stock vial of human PSCs with prewarmed ES medium.
Centrifuge the cells in 800 rpm at 20°C for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in ES medium and seed on the culture dishes coated with feeder cells.
Change the medium every day starting two days post-seeding.
Passage the cells when they become 80 - 90% confluent in culture.
Discard the medium and wash the dishes twice with PBS (5 ml / 6-cm or 10 ml / 10-cm dish).
Add CTK solution (2 ml / 10-cm dish or 0.8 ml / 6-cm dish) and incubate until detachment of feeder cells at 37°C.
Discard CTK solution.
Wash cells twice with PBS gently.
Detach remaining cells using a disposable cell scraper.
Discard the medium from dishes of feeder cells.
Pipette cell suspension gently several times to collect it.
Sub-culture the collected cell suspension on feeder cells.
Warm Essential 8 medium at 37°C.
Thaw a stock vial of human PSCs with prewarmed Essential 8 medium quickly but gently.
Centrifuge the cells in 900 rpm at 20°C for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in Essential 8 medium and plate on coated dishes.
Supplement Y27632 (10 μM) if cell viability is low.
Change the medium every day.
Passage the cells when they become 90% confluent, adding Y27632 at least one hour before passage.
Discard the medium from culture dishes.
Wash the dishes twice with PBS.
Add prewarmed 0.5 mM EDTA/PBS to the dishes and incubate for 5 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Incubate cells with 0.5 mM EDTA/PBS.
Discard 0.5 mM EDTA/PBS carefully.
Add Essential 8 medium to the cells.
Pipette gently several times to collect cell suspension in a tube.
Sub-culture the cell suspension on Geltrex-coated dishes.
Split cells at a ratio of 1:3 when passing.
Prepare CTK solution as described previously.
Mix DMEM/F12, KSR, L-glutamine, NEAA, 2-meraptoethanol, and Penicillin/Streptomycin to prepare RES medium.
Supplement RES medium with bFGF at a concentration of 5 ng/ml.
Add Y27632 to RES medium at a concentration of 10 µM.
Prepare Endoderm induction medium by supplementing RPMI1640 medium with Activin A, CHIR99021, B27 supplement, and penicillin/streptomycin.

Mix Anteriorization medium components including DMEM/F12 plus Glutamax medium, B27 supplement, penicillin/streptomycin, L-ascorbic acid, monothioglycerol, human Noggin, and SB431542 on the day of use.
Warm PBS before starting induction.
Prepare Y27632 at 10 µM and add it to 80 – 90 % confluent PSCs at least 1 hour before proceeding with the protocol.
Discard the medium.
Wash the dishes twice with PBS (5ml / 6-cm or 10 ml / 10-cm dish).
Add CTK solution (2ml / 10-cm dish or 0.8 ml / 6-cm dish) and incubate until detachment of feeder cells at 37°C.
Discard CTK solution.
Wash twice with PBS gently.
Add Accutase (2ml / 10-cm or 0.8 ml / 6-cm dish) and incubate for 20 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add RES medium (4ml / 10-cm or 1.6 ml / 6-cm dish).
Repeat pipetting gently using P-1000 tip to make single-cell suspension.
Centrifuge the cell suspension in 800 rpm, 20 °C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 10 ml of RES medium.
Plate the resuspended cells on a gelatin-coated dish after discarding gelatin.
Swing the dish gently several times to collect the cell suspension.
Count the number of cells.
Transfer the required amount of cell suspension to a 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 800 rpm for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cells in 2 ml/well of endoderm induction medium supplemented with Y27632 (10 µM).
Seed the cells on a Geltrex-coated 6-well plate.
Add 1 µl/well of NaB stock solution (0.25 mM) 24 hours after seeding.
Replace the endoderm induction medium on day 2 and day 4.
Discard the endoderm induction medium on day 6.
Wash twice with 2 ml/well of prewarmed PBS quickly.
Add 2 ml/well of anteriorization medium and change the medium on day 8.
Discard the medium on day 10.
Wash twice with 2 ml/well of prewarmed PBS.
Wash cells quickly with warmed PBS.
Add 2 ml per well of ventralization medium and change the medium on day 12.
Replace with 2ml per well of CFKD preconditioning medium on day 14.
Change the CFKD preconditioning medium on day 16, 18, and 20.
Isolate CPM high progenitor cells as described in Section D.
Thaw a stock vial containing 1.0 ×10^6 cells of fibroblasts with 10 ml of prewarmed 2% FBS / DMEM.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 900 rpm for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 6 ml of fibroblast culture medium.
Prepare three 10-cm dishes with fibroblast culture medium (8 ml / dish).
Add 2 ml of the cell suspension to each 10-cm dish prepared.
Change the medium every three days.
Reconstitute Ham’s F12 medium.
Add dexamethasone at a concentration of 50 nM to the medium.
Add IBMX at a concentration of 100 μM to the medium.
Add B27 supplement at 1% to the medium.
Add BSA at 0.25% to the medium.
Add HEPES at 15 mM to the medium.
Add CaCl2 at 0.8 mM to the medium.
Add ITS premix at 0.1% to the medium.
Prepare a fresh solution of 8-Br-cAMP at 100 μM daily.
Prepare a fresh human KGF solution at 10 ng/ml daily.
Add penicillin/streptomycin at 50 U/ml to the medium.
Warm PBS and 0.1% Trypsin/EDTA before use.
Cool centrifuge at 4°C for cell processing.
Cool 2% FBS/DMEM at 4°C before use.
Add 1 ml of alveolarization medium supplemented with Y27632 to each well in a 12-well plate.
Attach the 12-well cell culture insert to the 12-well plate containing the medium.
Remove the medium and wash dishes twice with prewarmed PBS.
Add 1 ml of prewarmed 0.1% Trypsin/EDTA per 10-cm dish.
Incubate the cells in 37°C for 5 minutes in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 4 ml of 2% FBS/DMEM to each dish and collect cell suspension into tubes.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 900 rpm for 5 minutes at 20°C.
Resuspend cells in 2% FBS/DMEM at a concentration of 4.0 × 10^6 cells/ml.
Prepare the required volume of mixture of CPM<sup>high</sup> progenitor cells and fibroblasts (1.0 × 10^4 cells/well and 5.0 × 10^5 cells/well).
Centrifuge the mixed cell suspension at 900 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant carefully and resuspend mixed cells in alveolarization medium supplemented with Y27632 (10 µM).
Dispense the cell suspension into 100 µl aliquots.
Mix the cell suspension with an equal volume of Matrigel on ice.
Seed a total volume of 200 µl per sample onto a cell culture insert prepared in step 1.
Change the alveolarization medium without Y27632 every 2 days for 14 days.
Warm the required amount (2 ml/well) of 0.1% Trypsin/EDTA.
Cool the centrifuge at 4 °C.
Cool 2% FBS/DMEM at 4 °C.
Prepare anti-EpCAM antibody solution by mixing 10 µl per 1.0 × 10^7 cells of APC-conjugated mouse anti-human EpCAM antibody diluted in FACS buffer (1:10) on the day of use.
Keep the prepared antibody solution away from light and store at 4 °C.
Prepare required number of 15 ml tubes with 6 ml of PBS in each tube.
Remove cell culture inserts from a 12-well plate using sterilized forceps and tap it on a 6-cm sterilized dish.
Mince the FD-AO to about 2 mm x 2 mm x 2 mm using sterilized forceps and a disposable scalpel.
Wash the dishes three times with 2 ml of PBS.
Collect the fragments in a 15 ml tube prepared in step 1.
Centrifuge the fragments at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 2 ml/tube of prewarmed 0.1% Trypsin/EDTA.
Incubate the tubes at 37 °C for 5 minutes.
Reduce fragment size by pipetting gently 10 times using P-1000 tips.
Incubate the tubes at 37 °C for 5 minutes.
Dissociate fragments by pipetting gently 10 to 15 times using P-1000 tips.
Incubate the tubes at 37 °C for 5 minutes.
Pipette 10 times again using P-1000 tips.
Neutralize 0.1% Trypsin/EDTA by adding 8 ml of precooled 2% FBS/DMEM.
Centrifuge the cells at 1,000 rpm for 7 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully collect the supernatant to another tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Collect recovered cells in one tube with 5 ml of FACS buffer.
Count the number of cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Incubate in anti-EpCAM antibody solution at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Keep away from light during incubation.
Add 5 ml per tube of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 900 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 5 ml per tube of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge them at 900 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 ml per 8.0 × 10^6 cells of FACS buffer with 1/1000 volume of PI stock solution.
Strain the cells through a cell strainer with 40 µm mesh.
Prepare cells for FACS in a round bottom tube capped with a cell strainer.
Prepare collection tubes with 1 ml per tube of FACS buffer for sorted cells.
Sort EpCAM^+ SFTPC^+ cells using FACS Aria II or Aria III.
Centrifuge the cells at 1,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 500 µl of FACS buffer.
Suspend 2.0 × 10^5 CPM^high progenitor cells in 250 μl of FF alveolarization medium.
Add the cell suspension onto a non-adherent surface 96-well plate.
Collect cell aggregates into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube by gently pipetting and aspirate using P-1000 tip on day 2.
Wash the wells with FACS buffer once and collect the remained cell aggregates.
Spin down the cell aggregates for 3 minutes using a tabletop personal centrifuge.
Remove the supernatant using P-1000 tip.
Remove the remaining supernatant carefully using P-200 tip.
Resuspend the cell aggregates in 20 μl of precooled Matrigel and place onto a well of 12-well cell culture plate quickly.
Incubate the cell culture plate for 20 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 1 ml of FF alveolarization medium and change the medium on day 2, 4, and 6.
